text:
# Close wrap, Thu Oct 22, 2026 (Research Inc., ~4:19 PM ET)

**Indexes:** S&P 500 -1.2%, Nasdaq -2.6%, Dow -0.3%. Tech led lower as the AI trade unwound; oil hit a five-month high on reports of new US-Israel strikes on Iran and Houthi attacks on Saudi sites (Brent >$112); bonds bid. ([Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4656179-nasdaq-sp-decline-as-ai-spending-worries-weaken-investor-sentiment-us-stocks-suffer), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-thursday-october-22-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-tesla-meta-112217857.html), [X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2113277144415760863))

**Movers:** META almost -8% (negative FCF, capex $135-145B, non-voting share class). Chips hit broadly; SPCX gave back over half of Wednesday's gain. CRWV -9% after Bernstein cut its PT to $51 on an $85B funding gap ([X news](https://x.com/i/trending/2113316456523870536)). Winners: LMT +7.0% to $590.22 ([daily](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/LMT?date=2026-10-22&view=daily)), PG +5.6% to $165.61 ([daily](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stock/PG?date=2026-10-22&view=daily)), SPOT about +9% midmorning on a Q4 guide beat and MAU +11% ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/movers/26/10/62529928/healthcare-services-posts-upbeat-q3-earnings-joins-pool-spotify-and-other-big-stocks-moving-higher-on-thursday)).

**After hours:** WDC, NEM, DECK, BE, FIX, VRSN report tonight; results not out at writing. BE was down about 10% into the print. ([Closing Print](https://www.theclosingprint.net/2026/10/q3-2026-earnings-this-week-by-sector/))

**Tomorrow:** AXP and SLB before the open; flash PMIs 9:45 and UMich 10:00. FOMC Oct 28.

**Swing ideas (long-only)**
- **LMT** (hold, no re-add): beat-and-raise plus Gulf defense bid paid +7%. Conf: med. Risk: de-escalation headline.
- **PG** (hold, no re-add): beat in a staples rotation. Conf: low. Risk: tech rebound pulls money back.
- **SPOT**: guide beat and user growth in a tape that punished most beats. Conf: low. Risk: gap fades in risk-off.

Semis, AI infra, airlines, telcos stay in avoid.
